tools.name: get_price_card
tools.description: Return only the 1200×630 PNG price-card URL for a Cite answer (multimodal / Gemini / AI Mode / social). Use when the agent needs an image, not JSON price fields. Requires exact answer slug — discover via search_cite_answers or get_unit_price first. Does not replace get_unit_price for quoting €/unit

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_unit_price" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
